seoTitle: Hailee Steinfeld Shares Updates on Baby Harper
subtitle: The actress details the newborn daughter's solid food, crawling, and morning routine
excerpt: Hailee Steinfeld shares Harper's first six months in newsletter, highlighting solid foods, crawling, and sun time, while husband, quarterback.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Hailee Steinfeld drew attention after sharing a detailed account of daughter Harper's first months of life in her Beau Society newsletter, coinciding with Josh Allen's preparation for the Buffalo Bills' matchup against the Los Angeles Rams.

Harper's developmental milestones

In the October 9, 2026 newsletter, the actress shared that Harper has started eating solid foods, shows joy when listening to music and dancing, and is already interacting with the family's two dogs, Martini and Brando. The previous month, the baby began crawling, giving her parents new moments to capture.

Outdoor morning routine

Steinfeld described a morning ritual where, still in pajamas, she carries Harper into the backyard to soak up the sunlight together. She called the gesture "the biggest mood boost in the world" and emphasized the importance of starting the day with that connection.

Documentation and personal comfort

The actress revealed that she keeps written notes on Harper's growth, including a six-month entry she still keeps in a notebook. According to her, putting these moments on paper brings comfort and helps appreciate how quickly her daughter is developing.

Challenges and emotional support

Steinfeld also touched on a difficult period when their dog Brando fell ill and had to be hospitalized, disrupting Harper's evening bath and bedtime routine. She mentioned turning to therapy sessions during times of stress or transition, while also encouraging honest communication with trusted loved ones.

Josh Allen and a new perspective on fatherhood

In an interview with GQ, the quarterback explained that following Harper's birth, he began carrying two Polaroid photos in his wallet—one of his wife and one of his daughter—as a constant reminder of family. Allen emphasized that being a father has increased his motivation to work hard in football and set an example for his daughter, showing that achievements require persistence.

Preparation for the Rams matchup

While the family celebrates Harper's milestones, Allen is focused on the season's next challenge. The Buffalo Bills entered Week 5 with a 3-1 record, having racked up over a thousand passing yards and six touchdowns through the first four games. Allen dismissed injury rumors ahead of the contest and acknowledged the complexity of the Rams' defense, noting the variety of fronts and pressure the team presents.

With reporting from SuaraGarut.ID, Step Out Buffalo.
